# **Sandy – Food Resources**


Sandy residents have access to local, nearby, state, and national food resources. All listings are focused solely on food assistance.


## **Local Resources**


**Hoodcourse Acres** 25297 E Welches Rd, Sandy, OR
Pop-Up / Drop-Off Food Location


**Coffee House 26** 67211 Hwy 26, Sandy, OR
Pop-Up / Drop-Off Food Location


**Mogul Mountain** 68278 E Welches Rd, Sandy, OR
Pop-Up / Drop-Off Food Location


**Neighborhood Missions Free Food Market – Hoodland Lutheran Church** 59151 US-26, Sandy, OR 97055
Phone: 503-622-9213
Last Monday of the month, 9–10am | Distribution in parking lot | Open to all, no income verification
Free Food Box


**Sandy Action Center** 38982 Pioneer Blvd, Sandy, OR 97055
Phone: 503-668-4746
Wednesday & Friday, 10am–4pm | Visit once every 30 days | Bread walk-ins daily | Clothing card available
Free Food Box


**St. Michael’s Church** 18090 SE Langensand Rd, Sandy, OR 97055
Phone: 503-668-3386
Thursdays, 10am–2pm
Free Food Box


## **Nearby Resources**


**Gleaners – Clackamas County** 13821 Fir St, Oregon City, OR |[gleanerscc.org/how-to-join](https://www.gleanerscc.org/how-to-join) Monday–Friday, 9–11:30am | Twice-per-year food box | Bring ID & proof of Clackamas address
Free Food Box


## **State Resources**


**FoodFinder.org** –[foodfinder.oregonfoodbank.org](https://foodfinder.oregonfoodbank.org/?utm_source=chatgpt.com) Online map to locate free food resources near Sandy
Food Resource Locator


**Flying Coyote Farm** – Portland, Milwaukie, Welches & Sandy
Phone: 503-668-8624
CSA / Farm Program

CSA / Farm Program


## **National / App Resources**


**Too Good To Go** –[toogoodtogo.com](https://toogoodtogo.com/) App to rescue surplus restaurant food at discounted prices
Food Resource / Discounted Meals


**Local Businesses Offering Free Meals During SNAP Disruptions** –[KATU Article](https://katu.com/news/local/here-is-a-list-of-local-businesses-offering-free-food-to-people-losing-snap-benefits)


## **What You Need to Know**


- Pop-up and drop-off locations may vary; check ahead for availability.


- Bring photo ID when visiting food banks or pantries.


- Bread is available daily at Sandy Action Center by walk-in.


- CSA programs may require signup or membership; some offer financial assistance.


- Local and national apps like Too Good To Go can help access discounted or surplus meals.


- Hours and availability can change; call ahead to confirm service times.
